function config({spreadsheetId,productsSheet,historySheet,recipient}){for(const [k,v]of Object.entries({spreadsheetId,productsSheet,historySheet,recipient}))if(typeof v!=='string'||!v.trim()||v.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure '+k);if(productsSheet===historySheet||/[!\r\n]/.test(productsSheet+historySheet)||!/^[^\s@<>]+@[^\s@<>]+\.[^\s@<>]+$/.test(recipient)||/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(recipient))throw Error('Invalid sheet names or recipient');const quote=s=>"'"+s.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'";return{spreadsheetId,productsSheet,recipient,productsRange:quote(productsSheet)+'!A:ZZZ',historyRange:quote(historySheet)+'!A:C'}}

return [{json:config({spreadsheetId:'YOUR_SPREADSHEET_ID',productsSheet:'Products to Monitor',historySheet:'Price History',recipient:'YOUR_ALERT_EMAIL'})}];

function rows({values,sheetName}){if(typeof sheetName!=='string'||!sheetName.trim()||sheetName.includes('!'))throw Error('Configure the products sheet name');if(!Array.isArray(values))throw Error('Invalid sheet data');if(!values.length)return{items:[],sheetName};const h=values[0],required=['asin','name','pricing','product_url','alert_status','last_updated','price_change','average_rating','percent_change','alert_threshold_low','alert_threshold_high'];if(!Array.isArray(h)||required.some(k=>h.indexOf(k)<0||h.lastIndexOf(k)!==h.indexOf(k)))throw Error('Sheet requires unique product headers');const indexes=Object.fromEntries(required.map(k=>[k,h.indexOf(k)])),items=[],ids=new Set();for(let i=1;i<values.length;i++){const r=values[i];if(!Array.isArray(r))throw Error('Malformed row');if(!r.some(x=>x!==null&&x!==''))continue;const asin=String(r[indexes.asin]??'').trim();if(!/^[A-Z0-9]{10}$/.test(asin)||ids.has(asin))throw Error('Each product requires a unique 10-character ASIN');ids.add(asin);const low=Number(r[indexes.alert_threshold_low]),high=Number(r[indexes.alert_threshold_high]);if(r[indexes.alert_threshold_low]===''||r[indexes.alert_threshold_low]==null||r[indexes.alert_threshold_high]===''||r[indexes.alert_threshold_high]==null||!Number.isFinite(low)||!Number.isFinite(high)||low>=high)throw Error('Invalid alert thresholds');const prior=r[indexes.pricing];if(prior!==''&&prior!=null&&(!Number.isFinite(Number(prior))||Number(prior)<0))throw Error('Invalid previous price');items.push({asin,index:i+1,raw:r,indexes,low,high,prior:prior==null||prior===''?null:Number(prior)})}return{items,sheetName:sheetName.trim()}}

const c=$('Configure the sheets and alerts').first().json,r=rows({values:$input.first().json.values??[],sheetName:c.productsSheet});return r.items.map(json=>({json}));

function parse({body,asin}){if(!body||typeof body!=='object'||!body.data||typeof body.data!=='object')throw Error('Invalid ScrapeOps response');const d=body.data;if(typeof asin!=='string'||!/^[A-Z0-9]{10}$/.test(asin)||d.product_information?.ASIN!==asin)throw Error('Returned product ASIN does not match request');if(d.pricing===null||d.pricing===undefined||d.pricing==='')return{valid:false,product:{}};if(typeof d.pricing!=='string'||!/^\$?\s*(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d{1,2})?$/.test(d.pricing.trim()))throw Error('Ambiguous US dollar price');const price=Number(d.pricing.replace(/[$,\s]/g,''));if(!Number.isFinite(price)||price<=0)return{valid:false,product:{}};if(typeof d.name!=='string'||!d.name.trim()||d.name.length>300||/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/.test(d.name))throw Error('Missing product name');const rating=d.average_rating;if(rating!=null&&rating!==''&&(!Number.isFinite(Number(rating))||Number(rating)<0||Number(rating)>5))throw Error('Invalid product rating');return{valid:true,product:{price,name:d.name.trim(),rating:rating==null?'':rating}}}

return [{json:parse({body:$input.first().json,asin:$('Select the next product').item.json.asin})}];

parameters.url: ={{ (()=>{const c=$('Configure the sheets and alerts').first().json,i=$('Select the next product').item.json,n="'"+c.productsSheet.replace(/'/g,"''")+"'";return 'https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/'+encodeURIComponent(c.spreadsheetId)+'/values/'+encodeURIComponent(n+'!A'+i.index+':ZZZ'+i.index)})() }}

function confirm({totalUpdatedCells,history,alert,subject,body}){if(totalUpdatedCells!==8)throw Error('Sheet update not fully confirmed');return{history,alert,subject,body}}

return [{json:confirm({totalUpdatedCells:$input.first().json.totalUpdatedCells,...$('Prepare the price update').item.json})}];
